nodes.label: Phase 1 Scope
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 is deliberately limited to identity, profile facts, taxonomy, and authentication records; calculated Career Passport and recommendation state are deferred.

nodes.label: Ownership Contract
nodes.rationale: Write authority is divided by data ownership so callers cannot directly mutate calculated or security-sensitive fields.

nodes.label: Career Passport
nodes.rationale: Calculated Career Passport state belongs to a future Phase 2 model and service.

nodes.label: Schema Contract Tests
nodes.rationale: The default suite validates schemas and indexes without requiring live MongoDB persistence.
